inputs.label: NFL Blitz 2000 ROM (USA, Rev 1)
inputs.help: A ROM made from your own NFL Blitz 2000 (USA, Rev 1) cartridge, as .z64, .n64 or .v64.

steps.text: Open NFL Blitz VR from Library > Unknown Sources. In the start window, choose your ROM in Download. The game checks it and remembers it; after that, press Play.

notes: Quest 3 only. The guide does not name ROM extensions; .z64, .n64 and .v64 are assumed as for the other N64 recompilations.
